source_findings.finding: Relevant actual nasal-confusion research, but primary article says data available from author on request; supplements describe stimuli and aggregate tables. No author contacted and no recordings obtained.

Official metadata and checksum-verified README obtained. Audio/articulatory data open, but paper describes MFA automatic alignment, not independently transcribed actual learner phones. Not imported as error labels; large speaker archives not downloaded.

Inspected author repository READMEs and config: training code and unfinished evaluation; eval_model_path is a local placeholder. No ready trained checkpoint identified in inspected resources. No model was run; paper scores are not our results.

Paper uses manual actual-phone annotation of LATIC and two MagicHub corpora. Inspected article does not supply a usable model/annotation download. No accuracy or data availability inferred beyond the inspected article.

matrix.metadata_discrepancy: 2022 record describes six female/five male; archive has five SF/six SM identifiers, consistent with the 2025 associated article. No participant demographics inferred beyond identifiers.

asr_identity_anchors.purpose: Candidate code-to-content check only; not phonetic labels or pronunciation accuracy.

prospective_control.normal_basis: Published whole-recording manual pronunciation QC; not per-target actual-phone annotation.
prospective_control.scope: Within-speaker style stability and model correction outputs; cannot estimate error sensitivity or natural-population false-positive rate.

matrix.noise_limit: Lombard speech was induced by headphone noise in a booth; this is not a real-phone noisy-microphone test.
